title: कठपुतलाका कथामा लैङ्गिकता  {Sexuality in Puppet Narratives}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखमा अर्चना थापाको कठपुतला कथासङ्ग्रहका कथालाई पाठका रूपमा लिई ती कथामा समाजले नारी, पुरुष र तेस्रोलिङ्गीका व्यक्तिलाई गरेको विभेदी लैङ्गिक व्यवहारका विभिन्न पक्षको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । कठपुतलाका कथा लैङ्गिक चेतनाका कोणबाट महत्वपूर्ण रहेका र तिनका अन्तर्यमा नारीमाथिको दमन र त्यसका विरुद्ध निर्माण भएको चेतनाको स्वर, दमनमा परेका पुरुषका पीडा र तेस्रोलिङ्गीका समस्या के कसरी समेटिएका छन् भन्ने कुराको खोजी गरिएको छ । यसका लागि लैङ्गिकताको सिद्धान्तका आधारमा लैङ्गिक अध्ययनका आधारभूत मान्यतालाई कथा विश्लेषणका ढाँचाका रूपमा आलम्बन गरी कथाबाट प्राप्त तथ्याङ्कको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसका निम्ति कठपुतलाका आठवटै कथाको सघन पठन गरी लैङ्गिकताको विश्लेषण गर्न नारी र पुरुषमाथि हुने गरेको पितृसत्ताको दमन, नारीवादी प्रतिरोधी चेतनाको निर्माण, तेस्रोलिङ्गीमाथि गरिने सामाजिक विभेदको अवस्थालाई अध्ययनको आधार बनाइएको छ । कठपुतलाका कथाहरूमा पितृसत्ताको विरोध गरी नारी र पुरुषमाथि हुने विभेद र दमनका विरुद्ध सशक्त आवाज उठाइएको र परम्परागत लिङ्ग व्यवस्थाका आडमा ट्रासवुमनप्रति अझ थप हिंसा हुने तथ्य प्रस्तुत गर्दै त्यस सङ्ग्रहका कथाले लैङ्गिक चेतनाको निर्माणमा सशक्त आवाज प्रस्तुत गरेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In this research article, taking the stories in Archana Thapa's story collection Kathputala as the text, various aspects of the discriminatory gender behavior that society has shown toward women, men, and third-gender individuals have been analyzed. Kathputala's stories are important from the standpoint of gender consciousness, and an inquiry has been made into how, within their inner meaning, the voice of consciousness built against the oppression of women, the pain of men subjected to oppression, and the problems of third-gender individuals have been addressed. For this, on the basis of gender theory, the basic tenets of gender studies have been adopted as a framework for story analysis, and the data obtained from the stories have been analyzed. For this purpose, all eight stories of Kathputala were read intensively, and to analyze gender, patriarchal oppression of women and men, the construction of feminist resistant consciousness, and the state of social discrimination against third-gender individuals were made the basis of the study. Opposing patriarchy, the stories of Kathputala raise a powerful voice against the discrimination and oppression of women and men, and, presenting the fact that under the shelter of the traditional gender order violence against trans women increases even further, conclude that the stories of that collection present a powerful voice in the construction of gender consciousness.

For this, all eight stories of Kathputala were read closely, and, in order to analyse gender, patriarchal oppression of women and men, the construction of feminist resistant consciousness, and the state of social discrimination against third-gender individuals were made the basis of the inquiry. By opposing patriarchy, the stories of Kathputala raise a powerful voice against the discrimination and oppression of women and men, and, presenting the fact that under the cover of the traditional gender order violence against trans women increases still further, draw the conclusion that the stories of that collection present a powerful voice in the construction of gender consciousness.
australian_english: In this research article, taking the stories in Archana Thapa's story collection Kathputala as the text, various aspects of the discriminatory gender behaviour that society has shown toward women, men and third-gender individuals have been analysed. Kathputala's stories matter from a gender-consciousness point of view, and an inquiry has been made into how, within their inner meaning, the voice of consciousness built against the oppression of women, the pain of men caught in oppression, and the problems of third-gender individuals have been woven in. For this, on the basis of gender theory, the basic tenets of gender study have been taken up as a framework for story analysis, and the data drawn from the stories have been analysed. To that end, all eight stories of Kathputala were read closely, and to analyse gender, patriarchal oppression of women and men, the building of feminist resistant consciousness, and the state of social discrimination against third-gender individuals were taken as the basis of the study. Pushing back against patriarchy, the stories of Kathputala raise a strong voice against the discrimination and oppression of women and men, and, putting forward the fact that under the cover of the traditional gender order violence against trans women increases even more, reach the conclusion that the stories of that collection present a strong voice in the construction of gender consciousness.
informal_english: In this piece, I take the stories in Archana Thapa's collection Kathputala as my text and look at the different ways society discriminates against women, men and third-gender people on gender grounds, hey. Kathputala's stories are important for gender awareness, and I look at how, inside them, the voice of resistance built against women's oppression, the pain of men who are oppressed, and the problems faced by third-gender people have been worked in. To do this, I lean on gender theory and take the basic ideas of gender studies as a framework for analysing the stories and the data coming out of them. For that, I read all eight stories in the collection closely, and I use patriarchal oppression of women and men, the building of feminist resistant consciousness, and the social discrimination against third-gender people as the basis for the gender analysis. The stories push back against patriarchy and raise a strong voice against discrimination and oppression of women and men, and they also point out that under the old gender order violence against trans women gets even worse, so the conclusion I draw is that the stories of the collection give a strong voice to building gender consciousness, hey.
